'''Industrial Starports''' were a type of [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lazerian IV]]. Each Industrial Starport consisted of a [[Standard Class starport]], huge raw material storage facilities, several large [[Factory/Legends|factories]], warehouses, apartments for working staff, administrative offices, and a local [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of twenty-four [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] from either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] or the [[Kingdom of Devit]]'s [[Lazerian army]].<ref name="TSoK" />

The starports were off-limits to [[Free-trader|freetraders]] and [[Passenger freighter|passenger ships]], with only corporate haulers, [[Ore carrier/Legends|ore carriers]], and bulk cargo [[Freighter/Legends|ships]] being permitted to land and take off. The starports were connected to each other and the [[City/Legends|cities]] of Lazerian IV via [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]]. Many of these starports were located within the larger [[Lazeria City Starport]] in [[Lazeria City]].<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Industrial Starports were created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
